stages.logText: I met Anaeth, the gravekeeper, guarding the graveyard of Vilegard. She refused to let me pass through.
After I delivered the lyre to Wrye, she wanted my help again. This time to bring Rincel's remains back to the Vilegard graveyard. But first, I had to see the graveyard plot in his name.
Anaeth pointed me in the direction of the burial plots owned by Wrye.
I found Rincel's graveyard plot, with a reserved plot for his mother. The plot needed to be dug. I needed Anaeth's guidance.
Anaeth told me to meet Quasi, a gravedigger from Brimhaven, and bring him back to the Vilegard graveyard.
I met Quasi. He told me he was not allowed to leave Brimhaven without the permission of Brimhaven's church guard.
I asked the church guard if Quasi could go help Wrye with the gravedigging. The request was emphatically denied.
Quasi sold me a shovel instead. I had to go back to Anaeth.
Anaeth had carved the tombstone for Rincel. She told me to buy a coffin from Fallhaven's woodcutter before going to fetch Rincel's mortal remains in it.
I purchased the coffin from Jakrar.
I went to where Rincel's remains were buried and met Oluag. I asked him to help exhume Rincel's remains and bring them back to Vilegard in the coffin.
For a high price, Oluag agreed to exhume Rincel, put him in the coffin and carry it to Anaeth.
For a more reasonable price, Oluag agreed to exhume the body and put it in the coffin. I had to carry it back to Anaeth.
Since Oluag's prices were out of my reach, he refused to help me.
I exhumed Rincel and put him in the coffin. I had to carry it back to Anaeth.
Anaeth now has Rincel's coffin for safekeeping.
Anaeth and I dug Rincel's grave plot in preparation for his burial. We dug alternately. Once we were done, Anaeth asked me to go inform Wrye.
I informed Wrye that she was needed at Rincel's plot.
I returned to find the coffin in the grave, the carved tombstone in its proper place, and Anaeth, Jolnor and Wrye waiting.
Jolnor performed Rincel's last rites. It was a somber affair.
Wrye thanked me for bringing Rincel home. Jolnor asked me to meet him at the Vilegard church.
Jolnor paid off all my expenses and also gave me some Nor City gold coins. These may come in handy in Nor City.
Wrye paid the PC for their agreement to bring Rincel's body back to her.
Rincel's remains have been exhumed.
PC paid for the coffin.
Gillbert asked PC about his daughter's weak physique.
PC answered Gillbert about his daughter's weak physique.
PC has bought cooked fish from Mabyn.
PC found Lysa's grave.
In a remote house east of Lake Sutdover, I found a woman named Mabyn who told me about her ill daughter Zephyr and asked me to talk to her husband Gillbert if I wanted to help.
In a house west of Vilegard, I found a very concerned Gillbert at the bedside of his ill daughter Zephyr.
I told Gillbert I would ask other Shadow priests for help. But first, I must go to Jolnor.
I asked Jolnor about what ails Zephyr and he said he was unsure and agreed that I should go see Thoronir in Fallhaven.
I found Thoronir. He seemed to know what the illness was but he did not tell me. He told me to go to the potion merchant.
The potion merchant in Fallhaven told me about bonemeal poisoning.
The potion merchant told me about Shadowwater and told me to get it for the medicine. I must go to Vilegard to find it.
In Vilegard, I asked Jolnor for Shadowwater. He said he didn't have any left.
Jolnor told me about aged fish oil jelly which can be used as a substitute for Shadowwater. I must go to Gillbert to ask for it.
I told Gillbert about bonemeal poisoning. Initially hesitant, he believed me. I asked him for aged fish oil jelly. He told me to get it from Mabyn.
Mabyn gave me a potent aged fish oil jelly. I must take it to the Fallhaven potion merchant.
The potion merchant said that the fish oil jelly was excellent. He told me to get scales from ancient stone worms.
The potion merchant also said that these ancient stone worms can be found southwest of Gison's house, near the northern shore of Lake Sutdover.
I brought three Lithic scales to the potion merchant. He can now make the medicine.
The potion merchant gave me the Purifying ointment and instructions on how to use it.
I gave the ointment to Gillbert and taught him how to use it.
